prompts.title:
Create ONE alternate chapter-two title illustration by REDRAWING the art in input 1 with the powerful early-1990s Japanese hand-painted OVA aesthetic of the 1992 BASTARD!! anime. The story is a modern everyday shisha-craft drama; use the visual intensity and dramatic cel drawing as an artistic treatment.
Input 1 is the user's existing Chapter 2 title and exact composition/typography reference. Input 2 is the official original character Ageha, age 22, for face, hair, accessories and costume identity. Input 3 is the official protagonist Hajime, age 22, for identity and clothing.
LOCK the landscape 16:9 layout: the huge, dark, confident image of genius Ageha dominates the right two-thirds, while small Hajime stands in the lower center-left with his back to us, legs braced and fists down, looking up and facing her. This is a symbolic overwhelming shadow, not an actual giant or a supernatural plot event. Preserve their exact relative scale, pose, directions and camera. Keep the left title area clear and readable.
Ageha retains her friendly youthful adult face, amber eyes, honey-blonde TWIN PONYTAILS, pink and cream bear hair clips, gold hoops, black choker, heart necklace, leopard-print jacket, pink heart crop top and black pleated skirt. Her confidence should feel effortless and intimidating by scale and lighting, not by changing her into an older cruel villain. Hajime retains the same black cap, black hoodie and cargo trousers, in the same rear-facing stance.
Rebuild all character drawing as rich 1992 production cel art: organic black ink contours with beautifully tapered fine detail, bold classic eyelids and expressive almond/tall eyes, sculpted flowing hair groups with large glossy cel highlight bands, dramatic angular navy/plum shadow masses, emphatic clean folds and warm cel-painted skin. Keep the skin and costume paint flat and opaque with 2-3 carefully designed tones. The character aura comes from spectacular orange-gold rim light and pink-violet backlight outlining hair and shoulders, with a deep shadowed face whose eyes and small assured smile remain discernible. Retain the source's magenta, black and purple abstract diagonal background rhythm, translated into painted animation background and graphic shadow shapes.
PRESERVE ALL EXISTING TYPOGRAPHY EXACTLY, including its Japanese characters, positions, line breaks, size, color and legibility: top-left '水煙前線 -EN:CODE-', below it 'CHAPTER 2', the large left-middle chapter title '才能の壁', and the lower-left English subtitle 'Jealousy Haze'. Do not introduce any BASTARD!! logos or new wording. The composition must remain the same chapter title while the art becomes distinctly hand-drawn 1990s OVA.
No new armor, swords, horns, extra characters, equipment, nudity or watermark. Deliver one full-bleed landscape 16:9 finished title image.
